name: evaluate-contribution
comment: Declaring dependencies here is what keeps the Studio out of this function's
bundle. Without this file the CLI resolves from the repository root, and the
deployed asset came to 43MB: rxjs, zod and the Studio's screenshots and
favicon, none of which this function imports. Sanity's guidance is that a
larger function is a slower one, and the cap is 200MB.
The trade-off left in place: `ai` pulls in zod, so roughly 17MB of what
remains is the AI SDK. Jev is one JSON POST, so a hand-rolled fetch would
remove that entirely -- but only against the Gateway's undocumented internal
protocol, or against api.typesafe.ai with a TypeSafe key we do not have.
src/contributionEvaluation/evaluate.ts is the only file that would change.
